title: Presence Cards
description: Two cards on a shared canvas, worked on live by four people at once.
docs:
Presence Cards — Two cards on a shared canvas, worked on live by four people at once.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Inter (300 to 700). If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.
